'''Thrust-Thru Flights''' was a large transport company based on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Edan II/Legends|Edan II]] in the city of [[Fortuna City]]. Thrust-Thru was secondary to the primary transportation company [[Edan Spaceways]].
